skill.name: canvas-design
skill.description: Create visual design philosophies and express them as polished PNG or PDF canvas artwork with bundled font options.
skill.summary: Guides AI tools through design philosophy, composition, typography, and final canvas artwork creation.
skill.author: DYAI2025

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from font license text, Markdown backticks, and bundled font assets. No evidence of command execution, credential access, or prompt-injection behavior was found in the reviewed text. The remaining concern is an instruction that permits unrestricted external font downloads.

remediation.issue: Unrestricted font downloads are allowed by the skill instructions.
remediation.suggestion: Replace this with an allowlist of approved font sources or require user confirmation before any download.

remediation.issue: Bundled font binaries have limited provenance in the report.
remediation.suggestion: Publish source URLs, license names, and checksums for each bundled font file.

content.value_statement: Static artwork requests often need stronger art direction than a simple layout prompt provides. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through a design philosophy and a refined visual canvas.
actual_capabilities: Creates a written design philosophy before visual production.
Guides creation of single-page PNG or PDF artwork.
Uses bundled font files from the canvas-fonts directory.
Emphasizes sparse text, composition, spacing, and visual hierarchy.
Supports multi-page visual sets when the user requests them.
Adds a refinement pass focused on polish and alignment.
limitations: It provides instructions, not a standalone rendering engine.
Final output quality depends on the host tool and available canvas libraries.
It may need user review for brand, legal, or accessibility requirements.
External font downloads should be disabled or restricted to trusted sources.

use_cases.title: Design Event Posters
use_cases.description: Create a refined poster concept with a visual philosophy, typography direction, and final artwork guidance.

use_cases.title: Produce Editorial Art
use_cases.description: Turn an abstract topic into a polished single-page image or PDF with restrained text and strong composition.

use_cases.title: Explore Art Directions
use_cases.description: Generate a named aesthetic movement and express it through color, space, form, and typography.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner Poster
prompt_templates.scenario: A user wants one polished visual asset from a simple brief.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a single-page PNG poster for a community lecture about urban gardens. Use the canvas-design skill and include a short design philosophy.

prompt_templates.title: Brand Mood Artwork
prompt_templates.scenario: A team needs a visual direction for a campaign theme.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use canvas-design to create a PDF artwork that expresses a calm, technical, and trustworthy identity for a climate data product.

prompt_templates.title: Editorial Visual System
prompt_templates.scenario: A publication needs an abstract image with clear conceptual depth.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a magazine-style PNG for an essay about memory and maps. Build a design philosophy first, then express it visually with minimal text.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Multi-Page Set
prompt_templates.scenario: A creative team wants a cohesive visual sequence.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use canvas-design to produce a three-page PDF art sequence for a music release. Keep each page distinct but tied to one visual philosophy.

output_examples.input: Create a poster for a night market opening.
output: A named visual philosophy for the market atmosphere.
A single-page PNG poster with bold composition and sparse text.
A refinement pass that improves spacing, typography, and margins.

output_examples.input: Make a PDF artwork for a research lab anniversary.
output: A design movement that treats research as a visual system.
A polished PDF with structured marks, restrained labels, and careful hierarchy.
Bundled fonts selected from the local canvas-fonts directory.

output_examples.input: Create a visual identity study for a ceramics studio.
output: A concise philosophy focused on texture, negative space, and material quietness.
A canvas composition with minimal text and strong spatial balance.

best_practices: Provide the subject, intended format, page count, and any required text before generation.
Review the design philosophy before final rendering when brand accuracy matters.
Use bundled fonts or approved font sources with clear licenses and provenance.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for copied styles from living artists or protected brand systems.
Do not rely on long paragraphs when the final artifact should be mostly visual.
Do not allow unrestricted downloads of fonts or assets in sensitive environments.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It guides creation of a design philosophy and a PNG or PDF canvas artwork.

faq.question: Does it include font assets?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes a canvas-fonts directory with bundled font files and license text.

faq.question: Can it make multi-page outputs?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports additional pages when the user requests a multi-page PDF or image set.

faq.question: Is it a rendering application?
faq.answer: No. It is an instruction skill that depends on the host AI tool and available rendering utilities.

faq.question: Can it copy a specific artist style?
faq.answer: No. The skill directs original visual designs and avoids copying existing artists.

faq.question: What should teams review before use?
faq.answer: Teams should review font provenance, brand fit, accessibility, and any external download behavior.
